deck_title: Enterprise First-Last-Frame (FLF2V) Keyframe Transition & Camera Bridge Pipeline: Bidirectional Latent Anchor + 6D Plücker Ray Bridge (c_flf = c_0/(1+u), 1.0000x Lock) vs Naive Open-Loop I2V Drift

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Enterprise First-Last-Frame (FLF2V) Keyframe Transition & Camera Bridge pipeline evaluation (clamping both start latent z_0 = E(I_start) and end latent z_T = E(I_end) as hard boundary conditions with 6D Plücker camera trajectory guidance so amortized unit cost c_flf(u) = c_0 / (1 + u) reaches 0.5000 at u = 1.0, locking C_active / C_flf = 1.0000x with 0.00px match-cut seam across all 17 stages u in [0.000, 1.000]) versus naive single-keyframe open-loop I2V generation (which drifts away from the target end keyframe at t = T, causing jarring jump-cuts and inflating retake cost by 1 + u to 1.2500x at S4, 1.5000x at S8, and 2.0000x at S16 across 16/17 stages) and 64-frame latent bridge quadrature.
